control_failures.control_label: secondary containment by bund and drainage
integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: thermal release during shift handover on P-4103

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system had degraded below its design intent, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the integrity of the mechanical seal support system on P-4103, M-4103 and V-4110 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in managing hydrocarbon transfer and storage, specifically transferring hydrocarbon between vessels. P-4103 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during shift handover while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 3 November 2009 an incident occurred on P-4103, M-4103 and V-4110 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during shift handover, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
